bibliographic.title: Slaughtertrain
bibliographic.author: Kent Sutherland, Rosstin Murphy, Laura Michet
bibliographic.description:
Plus Ultra brings you Slaughtertrain, a RANDOMIZED VIOLENCE ADVENTURE about a noble hero (you, of course) who must slaughter everyone on a post-apocalyptic train in order to complete a mission of redemption and revenge.

The game is is a LAVISH TEXT EXPERIENCE which contains over 100 DIFFERENT TRAIN CARS to explore and/or slaughter. Strong randomization and multiple difficulty settings offer you SEVERAL FASCINATING PLAYTHROUGHS.

With so many train cars and so many (3, specifically) different ways to interact with each train car, Slaughtertrain contains a truly astounding amount of jokes. it also contains an astounding amount of cartoonish violence and curse words! Slaughtertrain is not appropriate for children.

Slaughtertrain is the only review of SNOWPIERCER you ever need. Anyone with a strong opinion of any kind about that movie will probably enjoy this game. (You'll probably also enjoy it if you've never seen the movie but just like train violence.)
